The drawn diagrams lack geometric integrity; lines wobble unnaturally, perspective is inconsistent within single objects, and shapes appear to melt or fail to close properly.
The paper texture appears slightly overly smooth and uniform, lacking the subtle grain or shadow variations expected from stacked loose-leaf paper under lighting.
